course.title: This course
course.description: These settings can differ for each language you study.

pace.title: Learning pace
pace.description: How much you want to learn and review.
pace.streak_min_answersDesc: The answers you give in a day for it to count in your streak.
pace.new_per_weekDesc: How many new words, grammar points and characters you aim to start each week. Your study goals follow it.
pace.reviews_per_dayDesc: How many cards you aim to answer in your daily review. Your study goals follow it.
pace.soft_gateDesc: New material waits until the first lesson is known; you can always override.

review.title: What I review
review.description: What enters your review queue. The plan, side mix and exercise preferences are under Learning.
review.element_typesDesc: Only these types are reviewed in this course.
review.include_sharedDesc: Lessons others shared with you appear in your review.

answer.title: How I answer
answer.hints_enabledDesc: Show the hint buttons on cards.
answer.retry_wrongDesc: Up to 3 attempts on an exercise; only the last counts.
answer.calligraphy_draw_firstDesc: Calligraphy cards ask you to draw before showing the answer.
answer.calligraphy_stroke_guideDesc: Show the stroke order while drawing.
answer.audio_autoplayDesc: Play the clip when a card shows. Needs audio on the item.
answer.typing_strictnessDesc: Whether accents and case must match exactly, for this course.

see.title: Appearance
see.description: Scores, phonetics, interface language and theme.
see.show_scores: Show the score after each answer
see.show_scoresDesc: Off by default: scores are hidden after exercises.
see.themeDesc: Light, dark or follow the system.
see.show_phoneticsDesc: Pinyin or romaji, for this course.

skills.title: Skills
skills.description: Choose which skills to train. An item's score is the average of the skills in use; skills left off are ignored, not counted as zero.

presets.title: Presets
presets.description: A starting point: tap one to fill your pace and your study goals. Skills are not changed.
